Stranger Things 🎥 

Vecna doesn't see humans as evil, he sees them as inevitable. A species that multiplies without purpose, consumes without limit, and calls destruction - "growth, Eat, Sleep, Reproduce. It's not a curse, it's our cycle. We are draining our world, polluting our skies, poisoning our oceans, cutting our forests, melting our glaciers, choking our rivers, burning our fuels, killing our wildlife, wasting our resources, draining our soils, crowding our cities, dumping our plastics, exploiting our lands, mining our mountains, clearing our jungles, silencing our birds, drying our lakes, destroying our reefs, hunting our species, warming our planet, breaking our future and then act surprised when everything feels broken. Vecna's words sting because they sound cruel...but deep down, we know they come from truth. He's not celebrating chaos, he's exposing it. He represents the ugly truth about what happens when nature fights back against its own creation. That's what makes this scene terrifying not because it's supernatural or fantasy, but because it's real.

source_details.synopsis: Stranger Things is an American television series created by the Duffer Brothers for Netflix. Produced by Monkey Massacre Productions and 21 Laps Entertainment, the first season was released on Netflix on July 15, 2016. The second and third seasons followed in October 2017 and July 2019, respectively, and the fourth season was released in two volumes in May and July 2022. The fifth and final season was released in three volumes, including the finale, in November and December 2025. The show combines elements of horror, science fiction, mystery, coming-of-age, supernatural, and drama.
